name: device-control.check-app
purpose: Screenshot a phone or TV, or try an app on it: install an APK when one is given, open the app and verify it is in the foreground, then capture its screen.

device.description: Device id or unique display name

apk.description: Absolute path of an APK to install on a phone first; omit for an app that is already installed

app.description: App name or exact package when no apk is given

screenshot.description: Capture a screenshot after the app is in the foreground

assumptions: Device Control owns identity resolution, wake, transport selection, leases and evidence retention
invariants: Install is sent only when an apk is supplied; an app that is already installed is never reinstalled
Success needs the foreground observation and, when requested, a retained screenshot
A failure reports its next actions; nothing is retried on another device

signals.next_actions: exact commands that resolve a failure
signals.fetch: command that saves an evidence id
